newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on polyester fibre.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on polyester fibre.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Wednesday on rumours that polyester staple fibre makers will soon raise their prices, dealers said. Manufacturers have not confirmed or denied the reports.
The rumour helped boost polyester stocks, pushing up the index, a dealer at Ali Husain Rajabali said. "The market remained bullish throughout the day," he said.
The Karachi 100-share index closed 10.93 points, or 0.76 percent, higher at 1,444.99 amid 122 losers and 118 gainers.
The upward momentum in the polyester stocks led to positive sentiment across the board, dealer Asif Janmohammad said.

Dewan Salman Fibre jumped 2.80 rupees to 31.30, Pakistan Synthetics 1.45 to 12.80, Dhan Fibre 0.50 to 4.20 and Gatron Industries 0.50 to 32. Hub Power rose 0.55 to 34. PTCL shed 0.15 to 32.05 and Dawood Hercules 18 to 125.
